title: Kaikadi people - Wikipedia
text: The Kaikadi are a community in the Indian states of Maharashtra and Karnataka. [1][2] Their name is derived from kai (meaning "hand") and kade (meaning "basket"), while the community derives its name from kai (a stand-in for a name) and kadi (a type of twig).
